Three layers are enough until the thermometer drops below freezing: a
base that wicks, a mid layer that insulates, and a shell that stops
wind and rain.

Boots are the piece worth buying once — trail shoes are fine on dry
ground and miserable in a wet crossing. The pack's hip padding is what
actually carries the weight. Renew the waterproofing spray every spring
and keep a dry set of clothes in the car for wet days out.
